decisions.rationale: 36 observed months, 5.24 mph vs 8.83 mph system median, deficit 3.60 mph - the largest in the batch. The slow-speed pattern is real and persistent (Midtown crosstown local). But every one of the 36 months used the system-wide fallback peer group (~327 routes including express), so the claim text's 'matched peer median' is not what was computed. Defensible as descriptive context ('well below the citywide median'), not as a matched-peer ranking.
decisions.notes: Peer group was the system-wide fallback for all 36 observed months; per-month methods recorded as 'system' with ~327 peer routes and a shared 8.83 mph median across the batch. mph/deficit arithmetic checked (median - route speed = recorded deficit); no reciprocal-metric inversion.

decisions.rationale: 36 months, 5.63 mph vs 8.83 system median, deficit 3.20 mph. Context only until a route-family/type peer group exists.
